{
  "name": "exo",
  "version": "0.136.0",
  "description": "Claude Code plugin with four stages and hooks that refuse risky commands.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Thomas Hoogteijling"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/blauwtje/exo",
  "repository": "https://github.com/blauwtje/exo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "skills",
    "agents",
    "delegates",
    "workflow",
    "planning",
    "debugging"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "specs": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where spec stores specs",
      "description": "docs: files under docs/specs. issues: GitHub issues. both: a file plus a linked issue. Not sure? Keep docs. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.",
      "options": [
        "docs",
        "issues",
        "both"
      ],
      "default": "docs"
    },
    "compression": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How compact replies are",
      "description": "short: short replies in small, easy words. shorter: just the answer and key facts, in easy words. off: normal full replies. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "short",
        "shorter"
      ],
      "default": "short"
    },
    "budget": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Agent model budget",
      "description": "off: no exo dispatch sets a model or effort, so every agent inherits the session. fast, balanced, quality: a hook sets each dispatch's model and effort from the column of that name in the kind table in lib/model-kinds.json. Not sure? Keep balanced. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "fast",
        "balanced",
        "quality"
      ],
      "default": "balanced"
    },
    "ship": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "How ship finishes a run",
      "description": "ask: ship puts the question. pr-merge: open a pull request and merge it once checks pass. open-pr: open a pull request and stop. push: push the branch. local: keep the commits on this machine. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "pr-merge",
        "open-pr",
        "push",
        "local"
      ],
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "workspace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where a code-changing run commits",
      "description": "ask: the run puts the question. branch: a new branch in this checkout. worktree: a new git worktree. current: the branch already checked out. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "branch",
        "worktree",
        "current"
      ],
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local env files in a run",
      "description": "ask: the run puts the question. copy: copy the local env files into the run's worktree. never: copy none. Not sure? Keep ask. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.",
      "options": [
        "ask",
        "copy",
        "never"
      ],
      "default": "ask"
    }
  }
}
